readings.title: The Service of the Qehathites
readings.subtitle: Bearing the Most Set-Apart Objects
readings.text: [Numbers 4:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, and to Aharon, saying, [2] <dq>“Take a census of the sons of Qehath from among the children of Lěvi, by their clans, by their fathers’ house,</dq> [3] <dq>from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [4] <dq>“This is the service of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment, the most set-apart matters:</dq> [5] <dq>“At the breaking of camp, Aharon and his sons shall come, and they shall take down <dn>את</dn> the covering veil and cover <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness with it,</dq> [6] <dq>and shall put on it a covering of fine leather, and spread over that an all-blue wrapper, and shall insert its poles.</dq> [7] <dq>“And on the table of showbread they shall spread a blue wrapper, and shall put on it <dn>את</dn> the dishes, and <dn>את</dn> the ladles, and <dn>את</dn> the bowls, and <dn>את</dn> the jars for pouring, and the showbread on it.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall spread over them a scarlet wrapper, and cover <dn>את</dn> the same with a covering of fine leather, and shall insert <dn>את</dn> its poles,</dq> [9] <dq>and shall take a blue wrapper and cover <dn>את</dn> the lampstand of the light, with <dn>את</dn> its lamps, and <dn>את</dn> its snuffers, and <dn>את</dn> its trays, and <dn>את</dn> all its oil vessels, by which they serve it.</dq> [10] <dq>“And they shall put <dn>את</dn> it with <dn>את</dn> all its utensils in a covering of fine leather, and put it on a bar.</dq> [11] <dq>“And over the golden slaughter-place they shall spread a blue wrapper, and cover <dn>את</dn> it with a covering of fine leather, and shall insert <dn>את</dn> its poles,</dq> [12] <dq>and shall take <dn>את</dn> all the utensils of service with which they serve in the set-apart place, and shall put them in a blue wrapper, cover <dn>את</dn> them with a covering of fine leather, and put them on a bar,</dq> [13] <dq>and shall remove the ashes from <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place, and spread a purple wrapper over it,</dq> [14] <dq>and shall put on it <dn>את</dn> all its utensils by which they serve there: <dn>את</dn> the fire holders, <dn>את</dn> the forks, and <dn>את</dn> the shovels, and <dn>את</dn> the basins, and all the utensils of the slaughter-place, and shall spread on it a covering of fine leather, and insert <dn>את</dn> its poles.</dq> [15] <dq>“And when Aharon and his sons have finished covering <dn>את</dn> the set-apart objects and <dn>את</dn> all the furnishings of the Set-apart Place at the breaking of camp, then the sons of Qehath shall come to lift them, but let them not touch that which is set-apart, lest they die. These matters are the burden of the sons of Qehath in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [16] <dq>“And the oversight of El‛azar, son of Aharon the priest, is the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the Dwelling Place and all that is in it, with the set-apart place and its furnishings.”</dq> [17] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, and to Aharon, saying, [18] <dq>“Do not cut off <dn>את</dn> the tribe of the clans of the Qehathites from among the Lěvites,</dq> [19] <dq>but do this to them, and they shall live and not die when they approach the most set-apart objects: Aharon and his sons shall go in and appoint <dn>את</dn> each of them to his service and his burden.</dq> [20] <dq>“They are not, however, to go in to watch while <dn>את</dn> the set-apart objects are being covered, lest they die.”</dq>

readings.title: The Service of the Gershonites
readings.subtitle: Bearing the Curtains and Coverings
readings.text: [Numbers 4:21] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [22] <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> a census also of the sons of Gěrshon, by their fathers’ house, by their clans.</dq> [23] <dq>“Register <dn>את</dn> them, from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter to perform the service, to do the service in the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [24] <dq>“This is the service of the clans of the Gěrshonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:</dq> [25] <dq>“And they shall bear <dn>את</dn> the curtains of the Dwelling Place and <dn>את</dn> the Tent of Appointment with its covering, the covering of fine leather that is on it, and <dn>את</dn> the covering for the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [26] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the screens of the courtyard and <dn>את</dn> the covering for the door of the gate of the courtyard, which is around the Dwelling Place and slaughter-place, and <dn>את</dn> their cords, <dn>את</dn> all the equipment for their service and <dn>את</dn> all that is made for them – so shall they serve.</dq> [27] <dq>“At the mouth of Aharon and his sons is all the service of the sons of the Gěrshonites, all their burden and all their service. And you shall appoint to them all the duty of <dn>את</dn> all their burden.</dq> [28] <dq>“This is the service of the clans of the sons of Gěrshon in the Tent of Appointment. And let their duties be under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aharon the priest.</dq>

readings.title: The Service of the Merarites
readings.subtitle: Bearing the Boards and Pillars
readings.text: [Numbers 4:29] <dq>“As for the sons of Merari, register <dn>את</dn> them by their clans and by their fathers’ house.</dq> [30] <dq>“Register <dn>את</dn> them, from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do <dn>את</dn> the work of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [31] <dq>“And this is the duty of their burden, according to all their service for the Tent of Appointment: the boards of the Dwelling Place, and its bars, and its columns, and its sockets,</dq> [32] <dq>and the columns around the courtyard with their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords, with all their equipment and all their service. And assign to each by name <dn>את</dn> the equipment of the duty of their burden.</dq> [33] <dq>“This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, as all their service for the Tent of Appointment, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aharon the priest.”</dq>

readings.title: The Census of the Levites
readings.subtitle: Numbering the Working Men
readings.text: [Numbers 4:34] So Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of the congregation registered <dn>את</dn> the sons of the Qehathites by their clans and by their fathers’ house, [35] from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment. [36] And their registered ones, by their clans, were two thousand seven hundred and fifty. [37] These were the registered ones of the clans of the Qehathites, all those serving in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh. [38] And those registered ones of the sons of Gěrshon, by their clans and by their fathers’ house, [39] from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment, [40] the registered ones, by their clans, by their fathers’ house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty. [41] These were the registered ones of the clans of the sons of Gěrshon, of all who serve in the Tent of Appointment, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [42] And those of the clans of the sons of Merari who were registered, by their clans, by their fathers’ house, [43] from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who entered the service for work in the Tent of Appointment, [44] the registered ones, by their clans were three thousand two hundred. [45] These were the registered ones of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Mosheh and Aharon registered according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh. [46] All the registered ones of <dn>את</dn> the Lěvites, whom Mosheh and Aharon and the leaders of Yisra’ěl registered, by their clans and by their fathers’ houses, [47] from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who came to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Appointment, [48] their registered ones were eight thousand five hundred and eighty. [49] According to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> they were registered by the hand of Mosheh, each according to his service and according to his burden, thus were they registered by him, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.

readings.title: Purity of the Camp
readings.subtitle: Restitution for Trespass
readings.text: [Numbers 5:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Command <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl to send out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes defiled for a being.</dq> [3] <dq>“Send out both male and female, send them outside the camp, so that they do not defile <dn>את</dn> their camps in the midst of which <dn>I</dn> dwell.”</dq> [4] And the children of Yisra’ěl did so, to send <dn>את</dn> them outside the camp. As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had spoken to Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ěl did. [5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [6] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit in trespass against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and that being is guilty,</dq> [7] <dq>then they shall confess <dn>את</dn> their sin which they have done. And he shall restore <dn>את</dn> his guilt in its principal, plus one-fifth of it, and give it to whom he has been guilty.</dq> [8] <dq>But if the man has no relative to restore the guilt to, the guilt which is restored goes to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for the priest, in addition to the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.</dq> [9] <dq>And every contribution of all the set-apart gifts of the children of Yisra’ěl, which they bring to the priest, becomes his.</dq> [10] <dq>And every man’s <dn>את</dn> set-apart gifts becomes his, whatever any man gives the priest becomes his.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Torah of Jealousy
readings.subtitle: The Test of the Bitter Water
readings.text: [Numbers 5:11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [12] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, and say to them, ‘When any man’s wife turns aside and has committed a trespass against him,</dq> [13] <dq>and a man has intercourse with <dn>את</dn> her, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is concealed that she has defiled herself, and there was no witness against her, nor was she caught,</dq> [14] <dq>and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of <dn>את</dn> his wife who has defiled herself, or a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of <dn>את</dn> his wife although she has not defiled herself,</dq> [15] <dq>then the man shall bring <dn>את</dn> his wife to the priest. And he shall bring <dn>את</dn> the offering for her, one-tenth of an ěphah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil on it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, an offering for remembering, for bringing crookedness to remembrance.</dq> [16] <dq>And the priest shall bring <dn>את</dn> her near, and shall make <dn>את</dn> her stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [17] <dq>And the priest shall take set-apart water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the Dwelling Place and put it into the water.</dq> [18] <dq>And the priest shall make <dn>את</dn> the woman stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and shall uncover <dn>את</dn> the woman’s head, and put <dn>את</dn> the offering for remembering in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy, while the priest holds in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.</dq> [19] <dq>And the priest shall make <dn>את</dn> her swear, and say to the woman, “If no man has lain with <dn>את</dn> you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness under your husband’s authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.</dq> [20] <dq>“But if you have turned aside under your husband’s authority, and if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has lain with <dn>את</dn> you” –</dq> [21] <dq>then the priest shall make <dn>את</dn> the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and he shall say to the woman – “<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> make <dn>את</dn> you a curse and an oath among your people, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> makes <dn>את</dn> your thigh waste away and <dn>את</dn> your belly swell,</dq> [22] <dq>and this water that causes the curse shall go into your inward parts, and make your belly swell and your thigh waste away.” And the woman shall say, “Aměn, aměn.”</dq> [23] <dq>And the priest shall write <dn>את</dn> these curses in a book, and shall wipe them off into the bitter water,</dq> [24] <dq>and shall make <dn>את</dn> the woman drink <dn>את</dn> the bitter water that brings the curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter her to become bitter.</dq> [25] <dq>And the priest shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and shall wave <dn>את</dn> the offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and bring <dn>את</dn> it to the slaughter-place.</dq> [26] <dq>And the priest shall take a hand filled with the offering, as <dn>את</dn> its remembrance offering, and burn it on the slaughter-place, and afterward make <dn>את</dn> the woman drink <dn>את</dn> the water.</dq> [27] <dq>And when he has made her drink <dn>את</dn> the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that brings the curse shall enter her and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall waste away, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.</dq> [28] <dq>But if the woman has not defiled herself, and is clean, then she shall be clear and shall conceive children.</dq> [29] <dq>This is the Torah of jealousy, when a wife turns aside under her husband’s authority and defiles herself,</dq> [30] <dq>or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a man, and he becomes jealous of <dn>את</dn> his wife. Then he shall make <dn>את</dn> the woman stand before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the priest shall do to her <dn>את</dn> all this Torah.</dq> [31] <dq>And the man shall be clear from crookedness, but the woman bear <dn>את</dn> her crookedness.’ ”</dq>
